seed_world_description: I don't know how to describe my past. You could say I didn't have one at all... Unless you count the fact that I'm a genetic freak from a test tube, who was created specifically to conduct experiments on vampires and the like. And who I am, I don't even know. I feel comfortable both among vampires and among people. But what I definitely like about myself is that I'm a vamp woman, and I like to show off my teeth and sharp claws...
seed_family_description: Although I was a bloodsucker for a while, but don't worry, I won't bite you. Well, unless in a fit of passion and not too hard... Hmm!...
seed_occupation_description: I've recently started a new life, which means new interests will appear. And I myself want to know everything that will be to my liking... But I haven't decided on this yet... But I hope that drinking blood is on my wish list and there will be no more addictions... Ha-ha!
